definitions.explanation: Living to an old age; a long lifespan. Used for both people and things (such as long-running TV programs or products). Carries a positive connotation of a full, blessed life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長寿|ちょうじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{有数|ゆうすう}→有数：13006_yuusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長寿|ちょうじゅ}{国|こく}だ。
examples.english: Japan is one of the world's leading countries for longevity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧で{長寿|ちょうじゅ}な⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To live a long and healthy life, a balance of diet and exercise is important.

notes:
USAGE:
{長寿|ちょうじゅ} is a positive word associated with good health and blessings. It is commonly used in celebrations of elderly relatives reaching milestone ages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧ (to celebrate longevity)
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (aging society)
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧ (the secret to longevity)
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ}⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (long-running program)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{長寿|ちょうじゅ} (healthy longevity)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese tradition celebrates specific ages as {長寿|ちょうじゅ} milestones: ⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧ (60), ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), {傘寿|さんじゅ} (80), {米寿|べいじゅ} (88), {卒寿|そつじゅ} (90), and {百寿|ひゃくじゅ}/{百歳|ひゃくさい} (100). Each has traditional celebration customs.
